paragraphs: The “Health & Beauty” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Health & Beauty, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Its immediate branches include Health Care, Jewelry Cleaning & Care, Personal Care.

Choose Health & Beauty when the product’s primary purpose fits this classification path. Compare its position with adjacent categories under Health & Beauty before assigning a product, using the product’s actual function rather than a promotional name. Where an immediate branch describes the product more precisely, follow that branch and continue to the most appropriate specific category.

The “Health Care” category belongs to Health & Beauty. It groups items under the official Shopify classification “Health & Beauty > Health Care”, keeping this product family distinct within its parent, Health & Beauty.
